lines.zh: 我走得很慢，你不必回头。
lines.en: I walk slowly. You need not look back.
I pass behind a tree.
There are my steps in the fog.
I walk the ridge line, away.
The grass bends a little under me.
I make no sound, and need not.
I am within twenty-five blocks.
One step more and I must go.
I keep to the rock wall.
My shadow arrives before I do.
I stand and keep watching.
Two minutes is not long to me.
If I do not move, you cannot make me out.

lines.zh: 那块石头，我站过很多次。
lines.en: I have stood on that stone many times.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，也没有好意。
lines.en: I mean neither harm nor good.
I do not sleep.
The wind passes through that empty spot.
I am twenty-five blocks from you.
When you look up, I will be there.
I say not a word.
What you see is all there is.
Can you measure how many blocks?
I keep my distance. That is the rule.
Your eyes are white like mine.
How long have you been in this world?
I am only watching.

lines.zh: 你叫我的名字，我也不会应。
lines.en: Call my name and I still will not answer.
I am not wounded.
You struck air.
That sensation left me long ago.
I withdrew, not from pain.
The blade passes through nothing.
I do not bleed.

lines.zh: 这一下，我留到下个夜里。
lines.en: I'll save this blow for another night.
I watched you swing a long while.
This body is only a shadow.
I should leave.
The man with white eyes needs no meals.
Raising that will do you no good.
I cannot take it, and will not.
Set it down.

lines.zh: 我离你二十五行格，刚好。
lines.en: Twenty-five blocks away. Just right.
I do not need your offering.
That is more use to you.
Keep it for the night.
I look, and take nothing.
Do not waste it on me.
You came near. I should go.
I withdraw before you.
You touched empty air.
I did not block your way.
Twenty-five blocks. You crossed it.
I vanish, leaving a gap.
Someone was here.
You turn, and I am not there.
I will not push you.
Do not follow. You will not catch me.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我已经不在了。
lines.en: By the time you look back, I'm gone.
I do not belong to this world.
I have only my watching.
I leave no offspring.

lines.zh: 一个人站久了，也就这样。
lines.en: Standing alone this long, it comes to this.
I have seen the shadow of my own kind.
It is watching you too.
We never speak.

lines.zh: 两个白色眼睛，看着同一片地。
lines.en: Two pairs of white eyes on the same ground.
Then each of us vanishes.
I never pick things up.
That thing fell at your feet.
I have taken it, and put it back.
Look again. It has moved.
I did not take it.
I need nothing.
It is on that chest over there.
I have seen what you are looking for.
I will not point it out.
You will find it yourself.
I have seen you. That is all.
You are remembered now.
I will be there tonight.
I will not raise a hand.
I only need two minutes.
I stand in the fog behind you.
Do not fear. Do not be at ease either.
What I choose is only to watch.
I begin counting.
You are at the window. I am in the tree.
How many times now?
I remember every face.
You are one of them.
At dawn, I leave.
I will come no closer.
One minute left.
You have not looked up again.
Twenty-five blocks. Almost there.
I will not put it out.
I wait for you to close the window.

lines.zh: 你走的那条路，我也走过。
lines.en: I have walked that road too.
Your dog did not bark.
It did not see me either.
I will stand a little longer.
You just blinked.
One more look at you.
There is not much to see, truly.
It is only that I am used to it.
You are still there.
Then I will go first.
Do not come looking.
I am no longer here.
I will not strike you.
I have never raised a hand.
My threat is standing here.
Your swing caught nothing.
I do nothing.
The harder you swing, the further I go.
This body cannot be touched.
I carry no weapon.
Your blade passes through me.
I am still watching you.
Do you understand now?
Striking me is not the way.
I never lift a hand.
That one counts as yours.
I have gone back five blocks.
Again will not help.
You are tired already.
I am still here.
And then I am not.
You can stop here.
I appear on the ridge first.
High enough here. Suitable.
The fog has not lifted.
I am at the edge of your vision.
The clouds pass below.
In the fog above, I open my eyes.
There is a village. I can see it.
I wait for one person to look up.

lines.zh: 这世界比上次大了一些。
lines.en: This world is somewhat larger than last time.

lines.zh: 我的白色眼睛，在暗处更亮。
lines.en: My white eyes shine brighter in the dark.
I choose this stone.
No one knows I have come.
Fire casts no shadow on me.
I come down from heights. I never fall.
Water does not reach me.
I am used to the sound of blasts.
The arrow passed through.
That spell cannot touch me.
I do not eat, and I am not hungry.
Lightning lights me for an instant.
I can stand in the void as well.
